description:
Configure the provided classroom scene for a Virtual Reality (VR) 360-degree render.

Your tasks:
1. Open the project '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/vr_classroom.blend' (already loaded).
2. Change the Render Engine to 'Cycles' (required for proper equirectangular projection).
3. Move the active camera to the center of the room at exactly Location X: -5.0m, Y: 0.0m, Z: 1.5m.
4. Change the Camera Type to 'Panoramic' and the Panorama Type to 'Equirectangular'.
5. Set the Resolution to a 2:1 aspect ratio: 2048px (X) by 1024px (Y).
6. Render the image and save it to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/classroom_360.png'.
7. Save the Blender project as '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/classroom_vr_setup.blend'.
